pairs.why: Both flasks are close; A has a smoother cork and a cleaner, more saturated glowing liquid, like the glossy juice glass, while B's oversized pale cork reads a little heavier.
B's cork and glass are smoother and less pitted, which matches the lesson that real cards are smooth rather than texture-y; A's cork is more porous.
B adds a pitted cork and fine bubbles up the neck, which is extra surface texture; A keeps the smoother, cleaner finish of the real cards.
A's cork is heavily pitted and there are bubbles in the neck, so it reads texture-y; B is smoother and closer to the real cards' finish.
Both corks are porous, but B adds more pitting and neck bubbles, so A is the slightly smoother and closer one.
A has the more textured pitted cork and the neck bubbles; B's smoother cork and glass sit closer to the real cards' clean gloss.
The two are almost identical; B's body has a slight panel seam that makes it read a little more like a built object, and the ground texture is about the same.
This is the same pair as q030 with the sides swapped; A (the seamed body) is very slightly more like a built object, and the two are otherwise interchangeable.
